## Problem

What problem would this feature solve?

Describe the current limitation or difficulty rather than only describing the
feature itself.

## Proposed solution

Describe how you think the feature should work.

## Example workflow

Explain how someone would use it.

1. The user ...
2. NODUS ...
3. The result ...

## Alternatives considered

Describe any alternative solutions or workarounds you considered.

## Visual example

Add a sketch, screenshot or mock-up when useful.

Do not upload private prompts, API keys or personal information.

## Who would benefit?

Explain which users or workflows would benefit from this feature.

## Additional context

Add any relevant technical information, examples or related projects.

## Checklist

- [ ] I searched existing Issues and Discussions.
- [ ] This request describes one focused feature.
- [ ] I explained the underlying problem.
- [ ] I understand that submitting a request does not guarantee implementation.
